abort_criteria_ordered: 1. Public promotion PR diff includes swarm-only artifacts (.adze/, plans/, swarm CI) without explicit acceptance -> abort promotion, do not publish.
2. Any release-graph check, package-boundary release gate, or cargo package --list check fails on public tree -> abort before any cargo publish.
3. Version mismatch: any of the 12 crates or inter-crate path dep != 0.10.0 -> abort.
4. crates.io dependency not yet visible when its dependent is reached -> stop mid-sequence; do not skip order.
5. verify-crates-io-install fails after publish -> do not announce install claim; file receipt gap under #325.
rollback_criteria_ordered: 1. Before any publish: close/withdraw the public promotion PR; no rollback needed (no tag/publish by this packet).

2. After partial publish, crates.io versions cannot be unpublished/deleted: yank affected 0.10.0 crates in reverse graph order (adze-cli first) via the token owner under #325, then publish a corrected patch release; do not reuse 0.10.0.
3. After tag: if publish is aborted post-tag, delete/move the v0.10.0 tag only by explicit release-owner decision and record it in #325; never silently retag a different tree as v0.10.0.
4. Yank/rollback decision owner: ABSENT (same as signing/token owner) - must be named under #325 before publishing.
